title: Store-Shed up blocked with yearling-combat copy during LURE
body:
During a committed LURE, Store-Shed **`up` is blocked** with yearling-combat / yearling-action copy while no yearling action is listed in that room yet (LAY often has not happened).

This 200-player grok-4.6 (low) MCP wave (build `36ff6d106fa0df2ff19e80d09cf00df081b81653`): S1 clusters `cf10a976446271fc` (34 reports), `673ec0ecdcfc551e` (23), `01c28908a726c8cd` (12). Example seeds: `1900000009`, `1900000011`, `1900000028`.

Fix: ladder block reasons must match the current LURE step. If the player is fetching feed, `up` should be legal or the block should name the actual missing feed/LAY step — not a yearling fight that is not on the action list.

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 low MCP 200-wave tickets cf10a976446271fc (34), 673ec0ecdcfc551e (23) on build 36ff6d10.
